author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series
content: Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series, and we want it to be the start of a long partnership, not a one-off gig. ... Pay: $3,000 flat for book one, in four $750 milestones. Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. To apply: Email belhumeur.books@gmail.com with your portfolio link, 3–5 samples showing the same characters across multiple scenes and angles plus sequential pages, a sentence or two about yourself, your availability, and confirmation your work is original and human-made (no generative AI).

title: LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST for weekly character art
content: Hello! I'm an ASMR RP creator on YouTube based overseas, and I'm looking for a reliable long-term artist to work with on a weekly basis for thumbnails and videos! I'm currently working with a limited budget, so I'm hoping to find an artist whose rates are a good fit for ongoing weekly commissions! I'm looking for: Weekly character art - 1x Simple rendered anime-style bust up or half body art of my OC per week (hopefully to be expanded to full body eventually once my income & budget increases!). Expression variations - Multiple facial expressions on the same art base - PSD file organized into separate layers. If interested, reply with your commission rates and relevant examples of your work! (new account for anonymity)

title: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES
